boundaries: Git records history and diffs; the Kit adds machine-readable operational state and handoff contracts.
GitHub PRs coordinate review; the Kit wraps PR lifecycle checks when evidence is available.
CI validates configured checks; the Kit records when remote target-CI is absent or not claimed.
AGENTS.md guides an executor; the Kit keeps durable governance, evidence and command metadata in the repository.
The executor is replaceable; repository governance persists.
The Kit itself makes no LLM API calls and does not require an LLM API; executor services may have their own costs.
YAML and JSON state are versioned, diffable and reviewable, but they create file volume and projection-refresh work.

brownfield.cycle_005_test_boundary: Cycle 005 changed CI configuration rather than functional code, so it has no historical local full-suite entry.
brownfield.generalization_boundary: stronger evidence than self-hosting, weaker evidence than an independent user adopting the Kit on an unrelated repository
brownfield.summary: Five real maintenance cycles in one familiar private Brownfield repository reached the B0 evaluability threshold: five real cycles, four merge-boundary cycles, legacy seams reduced from 72 to 58, and full-suite runs stayed green across cycles that ran them, growing from 1,483 to 1,490 tests. Cycle 005 changed CI configuration and has remote CI evidence but no historical local full-suite entry.
